mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart WHERE prdNo=#{prdNo} AND memId=#{memId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart(memId, prdNo, cartQty) SELECT #{memId}, #{prdNo}, LEAST(#{cartQty}, prdStock) FROM product WHERE prdNo=#{prdNo} AND prdStock > 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.cartNo, p.prdNo, p.prdName, p.prdPrice, c.cartQty, c.memId FROM product p, cart c WHERE p.prdNo=c.prdNo AND c.memId=#{memId} ORDER BY c.cartNo
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET cartQty=#{cartQty} WHERE cartNo=#{cartNo}
